title: Investigating LLMs as Voting Assistants via Contextual Augmentation: A Case Study on the European Parliament Elections 2024

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of LLMs in predicting the policy stances of various European political parties using the 'EU and I 2024' Voting Advice Application (VAA) questionnaire, and measuring performance disparities (representational fairness) across different political groups and ideologies.

Comparing the model's accuracy in predicting the political stances of national parties across different EU member states (Germany, France, Italy, and Spain) to identify geographic performance disparities.
